SELECT

    SUM(oqi.quantity * oqi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM

So, if you’re a perfectionist and you’re trying to control other people’s behavior, you’re going to be frustrated and disappointed. question: Is it accurate to say that 'electric cars have zero emissions'? Distinguish tailpipe emissions from lifecycle emissions using factual framing.

The lifecycle emissions of electric cars can vary depending on the source of the electricity used to power the car. If the electricity is generated from fossil fuels, then the lifecycle emissions of the electric car will be similar to those of a gasoline-powered car.
